features:
CLASSIC COOKIE MIX: Peanut butter cookies for the family to enjoy; each 7.2-oz. bag makes twelve 2-inch cookies

QUICK AND EASY: Just mix, drop and bake for a soft and chewy treat any time of the day or night

ENDLESS OPTIONS: Prepare cookie mix as is or explore Betty Crocker recipes for a new take on this classic sugar cookie

PEANUT BUTTER GOODNESS: Bite into sweet, soft and chewy peanut butter cookies; Serve peanut butter cookies for sweet celebrations and everyday moments

CONTAINS: 7.2 oz
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Sugar, Brown Sugar, Peanut Butter (peanuts, dextrose, hydrogenated canola and cottonseed oil, salt), Palm Oil, Whey, Baking Soda, Salt.
